'''Zavery''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A trader of speciality goods, Zavery was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the war, where he set up a stall within a [[Republic Supply Center]] located in the [[Republic Operational Headquarters]]. Zavery had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. While at his stall he wore yellow [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and spoke a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] to his customers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zavery first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as a speciality goods vendor on Quesh. The vendors location is also marked in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a strategy guide released for ''The Old Republic'' by [[Prima Games]]; however, it uses the name "Plaz Avery."
